close_reason:
Closed without changes. Two reasons:

1. The bead's empirical premise is wrong. It claims 'Same pattern in canonical jmap-mail-server/src/memory.rs:267-291 (demo_next_id with identical free-fn shape) — propagation needed.' but mail-server has no demo_next_id. It uses uuid::Uuid::new_v4() directly inside create_object (verified: memory/mod.rs:1113, 1131, 1276, 1632, 2030, 2611). The recommended cookie-cutter alignment doesn't exist.

2. The deeper question of whether demo_next_id should exist in extension siblings AT ALL is the workspace-design call open as bd:JMAP-3t94.5 (P1, human-labeled, 'MemoryBackend::demo_next_id diverges from canonical mail-server's uuid-based create_object'). Until that resolves, polishing the demo_next_id shape (free-fn → method on Inner) is either wasted work (if the answer is 'delete demo_next_id, use uuid directly') or premature (if the answer is 'keep demo_next_id with redesign X' the polish would be wrong).

The right canonical-template alignment is the larger-scope question, not the cosmetic polish. JMAP-3t94.5 owns that decision.
title: demo_next_id is an associated fn taking &mut Inner instead of a method on Inner
